purpose: Historical targeted meshing checks on full-resolution connector profiles before station reduction; final assembled-part validation supersedes these measurements
native_geometry: 18 additive measured-section BRep solids and two mechanical track cutters
sampling: 4000 area-weighted points per feature, random seed 42; root overlap faces within 0.03 mm of Z=47 excluded; distances to source triangles, not source vertices
limitations: Sampled distance checks are not a mathematical Hausdorff bound or a substitute for full assembled-part validation.
meshing_rationale: Angular tolerance 0.2 over-refined tiny C0 spans and produced microscopic omissions. Angular tolerance 1.0 retained the 0.005 mm absolute chord criterion and produced closed rail and bridge meshes without repair.
